verdict.rationale: The Solid README says the ecosystem is "growing fast" and includes component libraries. One community member reports porting react-bootstrap to Solid, so at least one Bootstrap-style component library exists. Another hands-on user says ecosystem gaps are real, citing a Framer Motion port that lags versions behind React. That suggests the ecosystem is present but not yet rich. Missing for 10: named, maintained third-party UI component libraries, evidence of breadth or richness comparable to mainstream frameworks, independent corroboration of library quality and maintenance.
